signature: MACHT HANNS [master’s mark: sun] DOLL MDCXXXVIII
literature: Wörthmüller 1955:403-04; Seifers 1976:145; Langwill 1980:41; Lane 1982:183; Fischer 1984:43; Waterhouse 1993:93; Herbert 2006:312.
remarks: 17 ferrules, dragon-scale pattern. Rather simple ornamentation. Tubular slide-stays, decorated with tendrils in ring-like pattern. Near slide-bow a flat stay with hinges and hooks.  Flat bell-stay, decorated with leaping wolf on one side and a stag on the other; three-pointed leaves on corners of both sides of bell-stay. Sleeve adjacent to bell-stay decorated with pomegranates. Simple ring in bell-bow. Proximal border of garland has notched pattern. The instrument is in good condition and playable, in spite of some dents in the bell.
